previous_sql: SELECT country_code, trade_name, gross_eur_minor FROM (SELECT ref_country.country_code, v_merchant_current.trade_name, fact_settlement_batch.gross_eur_minor, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ref_country.country_code ORDER BY fact_settlement_batch.gross_eur_minor DESC) as rank FROM fact_settlement_batch JOIN v_merchant_current ON fact_settlement_batch.merchant_sk = v_merchant_current.merchant_sk JOIN ref_country ON v_merchant_current.country_code = ref_country.country_code) AS ranked_merchants WHERE rank <= 3

sql: SELECT country_code, trade_name, gross_eur_minor FROM (SELECT rc.country_code, vmc.trade_name, fsb.gross_eur_minor, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rc.country_code ORDER BY fsb.gross_eur_minor DESC) as rank FROM fact_settlement_batch fsb JOIN v_merchant_current vmc ON fsb.merchant_sk = vmc.merchant_sk JOIN ref_country rc ON vmc.country_code = rc.country_code) AS ranked_merchants WHERE rank <= 3
